meta.name: discovery-interview
meta.description: Deep interview process to transform vague ideas into detailed specs. Works for technical and non-technical users.

copy.tagline: 把模糊想法转化为详细需求规格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需将模糊想法转化为可执行的产品需求
copy.tagline_en: Transform vague ideas into detailed product specs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn vague ideas into actionable product requirements

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude会通过一系列深度提问，帮你把模糊的想法变成详细、可执行的产品规格说明书。它会追问、检测知识盲区、做研究，直到完全理解你的需求后才输出文档。
howto.when: 当你提出一个产品想法（如“我想做一个分享食谱的App”）时触发。Claude会从问题定义开始，逐步深入各个维度，直到完成规格说明书。

say.text: 我想做一个帮人规划每日穿搭的App。
say.note: Claude会开始提问，了解你的目标用户、核心功能等。

say.text: 帮我设计一个后端API，用于管理用户订阅。
say.note: Claude会聚焦数据、扩展性、集成等后端相关维度。

say.text: 我有个想法但说不清楚，你能帮我梳理吗？
say.note: Claude会从最基础的问题开始，逐步引导你明确需求。

howto.what_en: Claude conducts a deep interview process to transform vague ideas into detailed, implementable specifications. It asks probing questions, detects knowledge gaps, performs research when needed, and only writes a spec after complete understanding.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you present a product idea (e.g., 'I want to build an app for sharing recipes'). Claude starts from problem definition and works through categories until a spec is generated.

say_en.text: I want to build an app that helps people plan daily outfits.
say_en.note: Claude will start asking questions about target users, core features, etc.

say_en.text: Design a backend API for managing user subscriptions.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on data, scaling, integrations, etc.

say_en.text: I have an idea but can't articulate it clearly. Can you help me refine it?
say_en.note: Claude will start with basic questions to guide you.
